scenes.heading: Marketing yourself without a big ad budget

sents.d: Marketing yourself without a big ad budget
Referral networks and a strong portfolio often outperform paid ads early on.
Early-stage videographers rarely have the budget or case-study library to run effective paid ads, so relationship-based marketing tends to produce a better return in the first year or two.

Partnering with complementary local businesses — photographers, event venues, marketing agencies that don't offer video in-house — creates a referral pipeline that costs nothing but relationship-building time.

A focused portfolio showing your best 3-5 projects, paired with client testimonials and a simple way to contact you, does more to convert an interested lead than a large but unfocused reel or an expensive ad campaign with no proof of past work yet.

take: Build referral partners and a focused portfolio before buying ads.
